articles.title: Luxical: High-Speed Lexical-Dense Text Embeddings
articles.abstract: Frontier language model quality increasingly hinges on our ability to organize web-scale text corpora for training. Today's dominant tools trade off speed and flexibility: lexical classifiers (e.g., FastText) are fast but limited to producing classification output scores, while the vector-valued outputs of transformer text embedding models flexibly support numerous workflows (e.g., clustering, classification, and retrieval) but are computationally expensive to produce. We introduce Luxical, a library for high-speed "lexical-dense" text embeddings that aims to recover the best properties of both approaches for web-scale text organization. Luxical combines sparse TF--IDF features, a small ReLU network, and a knowledge distillation training regimen to approximate large transformer embedding models at a fraction of their operational cost. In this technical report, we describe the Luxical architecture and training objective and evaluate a concrete Luxical model in two disparate applications: a targeted webcrawl document retrieval test and an end-to-end language model data curation task grounded in text classification. In these tasks we demonstrate speedups ranging from 3x to 100x over varying-sized neural baselines, and comparable to FastText model inference during the data curation task. On these evaluations, the tested Luxical model illustrates favorable compute/quality trade-offs for large-scale text organization, matching the quality of neural baselines. Luxical is available as open-source software at https://github.com/datologyai/luxical.
articles.comment: 9 pages, 6 figures. v2 fixes typos only. v3 corrects Luxical-One first-layer projection width typo (92 -> 96) and minor typographical errors
articles.titleCn: Luxical：高速词法密集文本嵌入
articles.abstractCn: 前沿语言模型的质量越来越依赖于我们组织大规模文本语料库进行训练的能力。当今主流工具在速度和灵活性之间进行权衡：词性分类器（例如FastText）速度快但仅限于生成分类输出分数，而Transformer文本嵌入模型的向量值输出灵活支持多种工作流程（例如聚类、分类和检索），但生成成本高昂。我们介绍了Luxical，一个用于高速“词性密集”文本嵌入的库，旨在结合两种方法的最佳特性用于大规模文本组织。Luxical结合了稀疏TF-IDF特征、小型ReLU网络和知识蒸馏训练方案，以极低成本近似大型Transformer嵌入模型。在本次技术报告中，我们描述了Luxical架构和训练目标，并在两个不同的应用中评估了一个具体的Luxical模型：一个针对网络爬虫文档检索的测试和一个基于文本分类的端到端语言模型数据管理任务。在这些任务中，我们展示了相比不同规模的神经基线模型，速度提升从3倍到100倍，在数据管理任务中与FastText模型推理速度相当。在这些评估中，测试的Luxical模型展示了在大规模文本组织中有利的计算/质量权衡，其质量与神经基线模型相当。Luxical作为开源软件可在https://github.com/datologyai/luxical获取。

articles.title: A History-Aware Visually Grounded Critic for Computer Use Agents
articles.abstract: Various test-time interventions for Computer Use Agents (CUAs), including critic models, have been developed to improve performance through pre-execution action evaluation in complex Graphical User Interface (GUI) environments. However, existing critics suffer from two key limitations: they (1) focus primarily on short-sighted decision loops (e.g., forgetting earlier actions) and (2) lack the visual grounding needed to detect flawed actions (e.g., clicking wrong UI elements). To address these, we introduce HiViG, a History-aware Visually Grounded test-time framework, built around a multimodal critic trained on real GUI trajectories to abstract past interactions into a compact record and to evaluate actions with visual grounding. At test time, HiViG integrates the critic into the policy decision loop to provide macro-action history, which summarizes the policy's completed achievements, and visually grounded critique, which verifies raw execution coordinates against the current screenshot to intercept errors before execution. Across web, mobile, and desktop benchmarks, HiViG consistently outperforms existing scalar and verbal critics, improving average success rates over the strongest baseline by 5.8% for Qwen3-VL-32B and 9.0% for Gemini-3-Flash, and demonstrates strong cross-platform generalization. Ablations show that macro-action history mitigates short-sighted planning and visually grounded critique reduces execution errors, with both components being critical for test-time scaling in long-horizon GUI tasks.
articles.titleCn: 一个具有历史感知能力的视觉基础评论家用于计算机使用代理
articles.abstractCn: 针对计算机使用代理（CUA），包括评价模型在内的多种测试时干预措施已被开发出来，通过在复杂的图形用户界面（GUI）环境中执行预执行动作评估来提升性能。然而，现有的评价模型存在两个关键局限性：它们（1）主要关注短视决策循环（例如，忽略先前的动作）以及（2）缺乏视觉基础，无法检测有缺陷的动作（例如，点击错误的UI元素）。为解决这些问题，我们引入了HiViG，一个具有历史感知和视觉基础的测试时框架，该框架围绕一个在真实GUI轨迹上训练的多模态评价模型构建，用于将过去的交互抽象为紧凑记录，并基于视觉基础进行动作评估。在测试时，HiViG将评价模型集成到策略决策循环中，提供宏观动作历史记录，该记录总结了策略已完成的成就，以及视觉基础的批评，该批评通过将原始执行坐标与当前屏幕截图进行验证来拦截执行前的错误。在网页、移动设备和桌面基准测试中，HiViG始终优于现有的标量和语言评价模型，在Qwen3-VL-32B上平均成功率比最强基线提高了5.8%，在Gemini-3-Flash上提高了9.0%，并展现出强大的跨平台泛化能力。消融实验表明，宏观动作历史记录缓解了短视规划，视觉基础的批评减少了执行错误，这两个组件对于长时程GUI任务的测试时扩展至关重要。

articles.title: MedGame: Storytelling Gamification Empowered by Large Language Models for Medical Education
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise for medical education, but most existing systems focus on localized interactions such as question answering or single-turn feedback, rather than organizing an entire clinical case into a decision-centered learning trajectory. We introduce \textit{MedGame}, a framework that transforms static clinical cases into structured, executable storytelling games. MedGame uses a dual-engine design: a Medical Narrative Designer synthesizes case-grounded clinical storylines with states and decision nodes, while a Story Director converts them into dependency-aware multimodal orchestration plans rendered by our released interactive platform. We construct MedGame Bench, a 5,000-case benchmark and evaluation protocol for Medical Narrative Generation and Story Direction. Experiments show that task-specific fine-tuning substantially improves open-source LLMs on MedGame Bench and narrows the gap with commercial models. A pilot student study further shows that learners perceive MedGame as more engaging and useful than text-only alternatives.
articles.comment: Work in Progress; an explorational design and study on AI+Education+Game. Updated an author's affiliation. A further revision (v3) is in preparation
articles.titleCn: MedGame：由大型语言模型赋能的医学教育叙事游戏化
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在医学教育领域展现出巨大潜力，但现有系统大多集中于本地化交互，如问答或单轮反馈，而非将整个临床案例组织成以决策为中心的学习轨迹。我们介绍了\textit{MedGame}，这是一个将静态临床案例转化为结构化、可执行叙事游戏的框架。MedGame采用双引擎设计：医疗叙事设计器将基于案例的临床故事线与状态和决策节点相结合，而故事导演则将这些内容转化为依赖感知的多模态编排计划，并由我们发布的交互式平台进行渲染。我们构建了MedGame Bench，这是一个包含5000个案例的医学叙事生成和故事指导基准及评估协议。实验表明，针对特定任务的微调能显著提升开源LLMs在MedGame Bench上的表现，并缩小其与商业模型的差距。一项初步的学生研究进一步表明，学习者认为MedGame比纯文本替代方案更具吸引力和实用性。

articles.title: AVA-Encoder: Learning to Represent Videos via Reconstruction-Driven Agentic Self-Evolution
articles.abstract: Agentic video creation systems remain far from cinematic-grade quality: their underlying models struggle to plan how story, characters, visuals, and sound fit together, and high-quality creation trajectories to learn such planning abilities are scarce. Finished human films embody this knowledge, but in a tightly coupled audiovisual form that agents cannot directly read or manipulate. We propose the Agentic Video "Auto-Encoder" (AVA-Encoder), which works backward from human films, turning them into agent-native video representations with reconstruction itself as the sole supervision. It encodes a film into a Film Knowledge Graph (Film KG) of structured-text nodes, typed dependency edges, and linked multimodal assets, then regenerates the film from this graph with a fixed decoder. Crucially, by distilling reconstruction residuals into textual gradients, AVA-Encoder drives a dual-loop self-evolution: an outer loop autonomously discovers a generalizable encoding strategy entirely from unlabeled videos, while an inner loop refines each video's Film KG at test time. AVA-Encoder improves reconstruction fidelity by 20.9 percentage points over the strongest baseline, and its autonomously learned strategy outperforms a human-tuned strategy using 70% fewer prompt tokens. Our representations drive three downstream breakthroughs: (1) Film KGs enable coordinated graph-based editing and (2) improve one-shot video generation across four open-source frameworks, while (3) fine-tuning agents on our reverse-engineered trajectories boosts video creation quality by 38.7%. We release the framework and a dataset of 500 Film KGs with over 27,000 creation trajectories.
articles.titleCn: AVA-编码器：通过重建驱动代理自进化学习视频表征
articles.abstractCn: 自主视频创作系统距离电影级质量仍相去甚远：其底层模型难以规划故事、角色、视觉和声音如何融合，而学习此类规划能力的高质量创作轨迹也十分匮乏。人类完成的影片蕴含着这种知识，但以紧密耦合的视听形式呈现，智能体无法直接读取或操控。我们提出了自主视频“自动编码器”（AVA-Encoder），该系统逆向工作于人类影片，将其转化为智能体友好的视频表示，并将重建过程本身作为唯一监督。它将影片编码为包含结构化文本节点、类型化依赖边和链接多模态资产的影片知识图谱（Film KG），然后通过固定解码器从该图谱中再生影片。关键在于，通过将重建残差蒸馏为文本梯度，AVA-Encoder驱动双重循环自我进化：外循环从无标签视频中自主发现可泛化的编码策略，内循环在测试时优化每个视频的Film KG。与最强基线相比，AVA-Encoder将重建保真度提升了20.9个百分点，其自主学习的策略在消耗70%更少的提示词的情况下优于人工调优策略。我们的表示推动了三个下游突破：（1）Film KGs实现协同图编辑，并改进了四个开源框架的一键式视频生成；（2）在逆向工程轨迹上微调智能体，使视频创作质量提升了38.7%。我们发布了该框架及包含500个Film KG（超过27,000条创作轨迹）的数据集。

articles.title: Can Language Models Learn to Forecast Stock Prices?
articles.abstract: We build BETA, a chronological sandbox over S&P 500 stocks in which a model calls tools to retrieve prices, indicators, and news available up to a decision date, and then forecasts the stock's future return. Evaluating frontier models in this sandbox reveals three systematic weaknesses: their scores decline as the test period approaches the present while a simple momentum baseline stays stable, they predict gains far more often than gains occur, and they predict moves much smaller than those that are realized. We then train models directly in the sandbox. We first fine-tune on filtered, hindsight-generated tool-use trajectories for historical tasks judged predictable from the evidence available at the time, teaching the model how to investigate a stock. We then apply reinforcement learning with rewards based on realized returns. During RL, long investigations frequently exceed the context window. We therefore introduce a selective compaction tool that allows the model to compress chosen portions of its interaction history. We address these challenges with Context-Aligned Turn-Level PPO, which uses a turn-level critic and computes policy updates using each turn's actual context. The resulting models, which we call AURA, substantially reduce all three weaknesses. Training improves the 8B model's score from 24.0 to 47.0 and the 30B model's from 27.4 to 54.7, with the latter surpassing all evaluated frontier models on our benchmark and achieving its largest margin on the most recent test period. These scores describe tasks selected for alignment between the available evidence and the realized return. Across all 412 candidates in the latest period, the trained 30B model still leads (35.17), while the trained 8B model scores below momentum (25.91 versus 28.33).
articles.titleCn: 语言模型能学会预测股票价格吗？
articles.abstractCn: 我们构建了BETA，一个基于标普500股票的时间顺序沙盒，其中模型调用工具来获取截止到决策日期的价格、指标和新闻，然后预测股票的未来回报。在这个沙盒中评估前沿模型揭示了三个系统性弱点：随着测试期接近现在，它们的得分下降，而简单的动量基线保持稳定；它们预测的收益远多于实际发生的收益；它们预测的变动远小于实际实现的变动。然后我们在沙盒中直接训练模型。我们首先在经过筛选、回顾性生成的工具使用轨迹上进行微调，这些历史任务被判断为可从当时可用的证据中预测，以此教模型如何研究股票。然后我们应用基于实际回报的强化学习。在强化学习期间，长时间的探究经常超过上下文窗口。因此我们引入了一种选择性压缩工具，允许模型压缩其交互历史中的选定部分。我们通过上下文对齐回合级PPO来解决这些挑战，该技术使用回合级评价者，并使用每个回合的实际上下文计算策略更新。由此产生的模型，我们称之为AURA，显著减少了所有三个弱点。训练将8B模型的得分从24.0提高到47.0，将30B模型的得分从27.4提高到54.7，后者在我们的基准测试中超越了所有评估的前沿模型，并在最新的测试期取得了最大的优势。这些得分描述了任务的选择，以实现可用证据与实际回报之间的对齐。在最新时期的所有412个候选者中，训练的30B模型仍然领先（35.17），而训练的8B模型的得分低于动量（25.91对比28.33）。

articles.title: PeerReveal: Learning to Generalize in AI Peer Review Detection
articles.abstract: Can we distinguish fully AI-generated reviews from those using AI only to rewrite human judgement? Furthermore, can we do so reliably when reviews are generated from diverse AI models and workflows across scientific domains? To this end, we introduce PeerReveal, a new detector that grounds its decisions in learned relationships between a review's claims and reference claims drawn from AI-generated reviews of the same paper, complemented by review-level textual signals. We evaluate PeerReveal on PeerShift, a new, challenging test set of 5,430 reviews spanning multiple domains, including machine learning, life sciences, and social sciences, combining variation in disciplinary review conventions with diverse AI review-production mechanisms. With regular training, PeerReveal achieves 70.52% pooled Macro-F1 on this benchmark, improving over the strongest baseline by 11.48 points. We develop an effective and practical adversarial training framework that further improves the detector's generalization using a small local generator optimized to produce challenging reviews, raising pooled Macro-F1 from 70.52% to 82.40%. These results show that robust AI-review detection benefits from richer review-level evidence and adversarial training on more challenging generation processes.
articles.titleCn: PeerReveal：在人工智能同行评审检测中学习泛化能力
articles.abstractCn: 我们能否区分完全由AI生成的评论与仅使用AI重写人类判断的评论？此外，当评论由不同科学领域的多种AI模型和工作流程生成时，我们能否可靠地进行区分？为此，我们引入了PeerReveal，这是一种新的检测器，它基于学习到的关系来做出决策，这些关系涉及评论中的主张与从同一篇论文的AI生成评论中提取的参考主张，并辅以评论级别的文本信号。我们在PeerShift上评估了PeerReveal，这是一个新的、具有挑战性的测试集，包含5,430条跨越多个领域的评论，包括机器学习、生命科学和社会科学，结合了不同学科评论惯例的变化以及多样化的AI评论生成机制。通过常规训练，PeerReveal在该基准上实现了70.52%的池化宏观F1分数，比最强的基线提高了11.48个百分点。我们开发了一个有效且实用的对抗训练框架，该框架使用一个小型本地生成器进一步提高了检测器的泛化能力，该生成器经过优化以生成具有挑战性的评论，将池化宏观F1分数从70.52%提高到82.40%。这些结果表明，稳健的AI评论检测受益于更丰富的评论级别证据和针对更具挑战性的生成过程的对抗训练。

articles.title: SEEL: Towards End-to-End 3D Sign Generation with Language Models
articles.abstract: 3D sign language generation aims to produce signing motion from written text. Motivated by the linguistic nature of sign language, recent methods combine a motion tokenizer with a language model to predict motion tokens from text. However, both components are optimized through a two-stage pipeline with mismatched objectives: the tokenizer minimizes reconstruction error in isolation, while the generator learns from rigid one-hot reference tokens. A straightforward end-to-end extension bridges discrete token selection with straight-through estimators (STE), suffering from biased gradients and codebook collapse. To address these limitations, we propose SEEL, an end-to-end framework that aligns tokenization and generation with motion quality through two complementary mechanisms. First, to overcome rigid one-hot supervision, reconstruction-aware generation decodes candidate tokens in context and converts their 3D motion errors into soft targets, guiding the generator with physical motion quality. Second, to propagate generation feedback without STE, generation-aware tokenization passes continuous codebook expectations through the frozen generator, routing generated-motion gradients to the tokenizer to prevent codebook collapse. Combining both mechanisms enables the tokenizer and generator to co-evolve, achieving state-of-the-art performance on CSL-Daily, How2Sign, and Phoenix-2014T. Code and models will be released to facilitate future research.
articles.titleCn: SEEL：基于语言模型的端到端三维标志生成方法
articles.abstractCn: 三维手语生成旨在将书面文本转化为手语动作。受手语语言特性的启发，最近的方法结合了动作分词器和语言模型，从文本中预测动作标记。然而，这两个组件通过具有不匹配目标的二阶段流程进行优化：分词器在孤立状态下最小化重建误差，而生成器从刚性的单热参考标记中学习。一个直接的端到端扩展通过直通估计器（STE）连接离散标记选择，但存在梯度偏差和码本坍塌问题。为解决这些限制，我们提出了SEEL，这是一个端到端框架，通过两种互补机制使分词和生成与动作质量保持一致。首先，为克服刚性的单热监督，重建感知生成在上下文中解码候选标记，并将它们的3D动作误差转换为软目标，通过物理动作质量指导生成器。其次，为在无需STE的情况下传播生成反馈，生成感知分词器通过冻结的生成器传递连续码本期望，将生成的动作梯度路由到分词器以防止码本坍塌。结合这两种机制使分词器和生成器能够协同进化，在CSL-Daily、How2Sign和Phoenix-2014T上实现了最先进的性能。代码和模型将发布以促进未来的研究。

articles.title: Aligned Machine: A Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Embedding Similarity via Human Comparative Judgements
articles.abstract: Embedding models increasingly inform how people search, recommend, and retrieve information, yet we lack credible ways to test whether these similarity judgments reflect how humans understand meaning. Existing benchmarks typically rely on static, expert-labeled pairs with coarse Likert-style annotations, limiting scalability and making it difficult to obtain consistent, high-confidence annotations. We introduce Aligned Machine, an interactive, public-facing platform that transforms broad participation into a continuously growing Human-Aligned Similarity Benchmark (HASB) for evaluating semantic alignment in embedding-based systems. Participants complete a cognitively-natural, forced-choice task, comparing two pairs of items (text or images) and selecting which pair is more similar. This comparative design is accessible to non-experts, yields clean preference data, and supports robust aggregation. We report results from an initial deployment with 115 participants contributing 2,875 total labeled pairs and 872 unique pairs. Using HASB, we evaluated 12 widely used embedding models and found only partial alignment between embedding similarity and human judgments. Text-only models consistently achieve higher overall agreement than multimodal models, while multimodal performance varies systematically by task type: alignment is strongest for image-image comparisons, weaker for image-text comparisons, and lowest for text-text comparisons. Aligned Machine is designed to evolve over time as participation grows, supporting longitudinal analysis, domain-specific studies, bias detection, and measurement of concept drift across model versions. By combining accessible public participation with rigorous comparative evaluation, HASB provides a scalable and accountable framework for auditing semantic alignment in embedding models.
articles.titleCn: 对齐机器：基于人类比较判断评估多模态嵌入相似性的基准
articles.abstractCn: 嵌入模型越来越多地影响着人们搜索、推荐和检索信息的方式，但我们缺乏可信的方法来测试这些相似性判断是否反映了人类对意义的理解。现有的基准通常依赖于静态的、专家标注的对，并带有粗糙的利克特式标注，这限制了可扩展性，并使得难以获得一致的高置信度标注。我们介绍了对齐机器（Aligned Machine），一个交互式、面向公众的平台，它将广泛参与转化为一个不断增长的人类对齐相似性基准（HASB），用于评估基于嵌入系统的语义对齐。参与者完成一个认知上自然的强制选择任务，比较两个物品对（文本或图像），并选择哪个对更相似。这种比较设计对非专家来说易于理解，产生干净的偏好数据，并支持稳健的聚合。我们报告了初始部署的结果，115名参与者贡献了2,875个总标注对和872个唯一对。使用HASB，我们评估了12种广泛使用的嵌入模型，发现嵌入相似性与人类判断之间只有部分对齐。纯文本模型在整体一致性上始终高于多模态模型，而多模态性能则系统地因任务类型而异：图像-图像比较的对齐性最强，图像-文本比较的对齐性较弱，文本-文本比较的对齐性最低。对齐机器设计为随着参与者的增长而不断发展，支持纵向分析、特定领域研究、偏差检测以及跨模型版本的漂移概念测量。通过结合易于访问的公众参与和严格的比较评估，HASB提供了一个可扩展和负责任的框架，用于审计嵌入模型中的语义对齐。

articles.title: Failure Broadens, Success Sharpens: Continual Adaptation of Tool-Use Agents Across Diverse Tasks with Dual-Polarity Memory
articles.abstract: Large language model agents can self-improve over time by utilizing procedural memory derived from prior task trajectories, yet the distinct utilities of memories derived from local successes and failures remain underexplored. This work studies this question in a realistic setting with heterogeneous streams of multi-domain tool-use tasks and various environment constraints common in real-world scenarios. We develop \emph{Dual-Polarity Memory with Periodic Maintenance} (DualPM), a simple, retrieval-free memory workflow characterized by (1) customizable reflection and procedural memory generation from both local successes and failures within each trajectory, and (2) periodic memory consolidation over long task streams under a given memory capacity, preventing memory explosion. Online prequential evaluation with fine-grained metrics reveals that failure memory more strongly broadens coverage, success memory better streamlines execution, while combining both polarities effectively integrates both benefits. Further studies demonstrate that DualPM enables cross-domain memory generalization and continual memory adaptation, while external evaluation on EvoMemBench reveals the portability and effectiveness of DualPM as a general long-term procedural memory method.
articles.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Towards Test-Time Continual Learning Agents
articles.titleCn: 失败使范围扩大，成功使焦点锐利：具有双极性记忆的工具使用代理在多样化任务中的持续适应
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型代理可以通过利用源自先前任务轨迹的程序记忆来随时间自我改进，然而源自局部成功和失败的记忆的独特效用仍待深入探索。本研究在一个具有异构多领域工具使用任务流和现实场景中常见的各种环境约束的现实环境中研究这一问题。我们开发了\emph{双极性记忆与周期性维护}（DualPM），这是一种简单、无需检索的记忆工作流程，其特点为：(1) 可定制的反思和程序记忆生成，源自每个轨迹中的局部成功和失败；(2) 在给定记忆容量的情况下，对长期任务流进行周期性记忆巩固，防止记忆爆炸。在线预序评估和细粒度指标揭示，失败记忆更有效地扩展覆盖范围，成功记忆更好地优化执行，而结合两种极性则有效地整合了这两种优势。进一步研究表明，DualPM能够实现跨领域记忆泛化和持续记忆适应，而EvoMemBench的外部评估揭示了DualPM作为通用长期程序记忆方法的可移植性和有效性。

articles.title: State Space Attention: Learning Context-Dependent Memory Retention
articles.abstract: Standard attention's key-value cache grows linearly with context length. Bounding it raises the question of what a sequence model should retain for long-context reasoning. We argue this choice should be learned, and introduce State Space Attention (SSA), which learns to keep a bounded set of past representations and reads them with standard attention. A learned scorer rescores every chunk against newly arriving context and the rest of memory. A fixed-context Transformer is then the special case that always keeps the most recent tokens. We train the scorer and reader jointly, either moving gradually from a differentiable soft weighting of memories to hard retention, or with hard retention from the start. To produce signal for the scorer, we generate supervised samples during training, a technique we call recovery. We compare SSA with recurrent models, bounded-memory attention methods, and full-attention Transformers across retrieval, variable tracking, multi-hop reasoning, and language modeling. On our retrieval and reasoning benchmarks, SSA matches or comes within a few points of full attention on most tasks, far outperforms a Transformer with the same readable budget on every long-context retrieval task we evaluate, and matches or outperforms one with about 4 times that budget, while using constant inference memory. The largest remaining gap to full attention at small language model scale is on RULER. SSA makes a fixed number of tokens useful over a longer context, and since it reads memory with standard attention, we propose that it can be stacked with KV cache eviction methods. We also pretrain and post-train 400M-parameter models and measure how SSA's training and inference costs scale with context length and model size. Together, these experiments examine the capabilities and limitations of learned memory retention for long-context sequence modeling.
articles.titleCn: 状态空间注意力：学习依赖上下文的记忆保持
articles.abstractCn: 标准注意力机制的关键值缓存随上下文长度线性增长。限制其大小引发了序列模型在长上下文推理中应保留何种信息的疑问。我们认为这一选择应通过学习完成，并引入了状态空间注意力（SSA），该机制学习保留一组有限的历史表示，并使用标准注意力机制读取它们。一个学习的评分器会针对新到达的上下文和其余记忆对每个片段重新评分。固定上下文Transformer则是始终保留最新标记的特殊情况。我们联合训练评分器和读取器，或逐步从可微分的软记忆权重过渡到硬保留，或从一开始就采用硬保留。为了为评分器生成信号，我们在训练过程中生成监督样本，这一技术我们称为恢复。我们在检索、变量跟踪、多跳推理和语言建模方面将SSA与循环模型、有界内存注意力方法和全注意力Transformer进行了比较。在我们的检索和推理基准测试中，SSA在大多数任务上与全注意力机制表现相当或略优，在所有我们评估的长上下文检索任务中，其表现远优于具有相同可读预算的Transformer，并且在使用约4倍预算的Transformer上表现相当或更优，同时保持恒定的推理内存。在小型语言模型规模下，SSA与全注意力机制之间最大的差距出现在RULER上。SSA使固定数量的标记在更长的上下文中发挥作用，并且因为它使用标准注意力机制读取内存，我们提出它可以与KV缓存驱逐方法堆叠使用。我们还预训练和后训练了400M参数模型，并测量了SSA的训练和推理成本如何随上下文长度和模型大小扩展。这些实验共同检验了学习记忆保留在长上下文序列建模中的能力和局限性。

articles.title: Sparse-to-Sparse Feature Learning for Cross-Layer Analysis and Steering
articles.abstract: Understanding how models internally represent information is a central challenge in interpretation and control. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose dense hidden representations into sparse features, and cross-layer methods capture structure spanning multiple layers. However, existing objectives do not explicitly train the sparse code at one layer to predict the sparse code at the next layer. We propose sparse-to-sparse feature learning (S2S), where sparse features at each intermediate layer are trained to predict those of the immediately following layer, with the final layer anchored by an output-distribution loss and optimization proceeding sequentially from output to input. Experiments across eight language models show stronger adjacent-layer correspondence than matched sparse-feature baselines. We evaluate feature-based interventions at matched output-distribution shift, separating steering-induced effects from sparse-pathway reconstruction effects. Causal ablation provides complementary evidence beyond correspondence metrics.
articles.titleCn: 跨层分析与引导的稀疏到稀疏特征学习
articles.abstractCn: 理解模型如何内部表征信息是解释和控制中的核心挑战。稀疏自动编码器（SAEs）将密集隐藏表征分解为稀疏特征，而跨层方法则捕捉跨越多层的结构。然而，现有目标并未明确训练某一层的稀疏码以预测下一层的稀疏码。我们提出了稀疏到稀疏特征学习（S2S），其中每层中间层的稀疏特征被训练以预测紧随其后的层的稀疏特征，最终层由输出分布损失锚定，优化过程从输出到输入依次进行。在八个语言模型上的实验表明，与匹配的稀疏特征基线相比，相邻层之间的对应性更强。我们在匹配的输出分布偏移下评估基于特征的干预，将转向诱导效应与稀疏路径重建效应分离开来。因果消融提供了除对应性指标之外的补充证据。

articles.title: Verifiable but Not Predictable: What Sentence Embeddings Know About Propositional Decomposition
articles.abstract: Quality control for proposition decomposition by large language models (LLMs) raises two asymmetric questions. After decomposition, one can verify: given a sentence and a candidate proposition, does the proposition belong to that sentence? Before decomposition, one would like to predict: how many propositions should the sentence yield? On PropSegmEnt, a corpus of English Wikipedia sentences each segmented by three human annotators, we find that the two questions live in different representational spaces. A natural language inference (NLI) judge verifies membership with 92.8% accuracy and an area under the ROC curve (AUC) of 0.977, and its residual errors turn out to be mostly propositions that are true in document context rather than genuine entailment mistakes. Vector geometry cannot verify: cosine similarity saturates, and a sentence embedding is not a linear combination of its propositions' embeddings. For prediction, every symbolic anchor we test, namely token count, the CPIDR idea-density counter, and a Neo-Davidsonian predicate count, reduces to a length proxy once token count is controlled. A linear ridge probe on sentence embeddings is the only predictor that keeps genuine count signal: its length-partialled correlation with human counts is 0.40-0.49 with bootstrap confidence intervals (CIs) excluding zero, and it orders length-matched sentence pairs correctly 67-71% of the time against a 50% chance level, statistically matching the inter-annotator agreement ceiling. This signal survives INT8 quantization without loss, INT4 at a small cost, and Matryoshka truncation to 256 dimensions, and it works as well in a 2021 encoder as in a 2025 one. Its structured weakness is a systematic under-splitting of long sentences. We distill the protocol lessons, including a retracted pilot study, into a checklist for probing length-confounded quantities.
articles.titleCn: 可验证但不可预测：句子嵌入对命题分解所知
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）对命题分解的质量控制提出了两个不对称问题。分解后可以验证：给定一个句子和一个候选命题，该命题是否属于该句子？分解前则希望预测：一个句子应该产生多少命题？在PropSegmEnt语料库（包含由三位人类标注者分割的英文维基百科句子）上，我们发现这两个问题存在于不同的表示空间中。自然语言推理（NLI）裁判以92.8%的准确率和0.977的ROC曲线下面积（AUC）验证成员资格，其残差错误主要是文档上下文中为真的命题，而非真正的蕴涵错误。向量几何无法验证：余弦相似度饱和，且句子嵌入不是其命题嵌入的线性组合。对于预测，我们测试的每个符号锚点——即词数、CPIDR思想密度计数器和Neo-Davidsonian谓词计数器——在控制词数后都简化为长度代理。句子嵌入的线性岭探测是唯一能保持真实计数信号的预测器：其与人类计数的长度偏相关系数为0.40-0.49，引导置信区间（CIs）不包含零，且在长度匹配的句子对排序中正确率达67-71%（50%的随机水平），统计上与标注者间协议的极限一致。该信号在INT8量化下无损，INT4有小损耗，经Matryoshka截断至256维后依然有效，在2021年的编码器与2025年的编码器中表现相同。其结构弱点是长句的系统性地过度分割。我们将包括撤回的初步研究在内的协议教训提炼为一份探测受长度混淆量清单。

articles.title: Rethinking Knowledge Distillation for Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Knowledge distillation has recently proven highly effective for improving autoregressive models, but its applicability to DLMs remains poorly understood. We present the first systematic study of KD for DLMs and uncover two non-intuitive failures of classical forward-KL (FKL) distillation: (i) student perplexity does not improve monotonically with more teacher-generated data, and (ii) on the same teacher-generated corpus, FKL distillation underperforms simply training the student with the original DLM denoising objective. To address them, we propose a unified, data-free distillation framework for masked DLMs. First, the framework runs an off-policy distillation phase that absorbs general knowledge from a static set of teacher-generated data. Then, the framework employs on-policy distillation which consists of three techniques: a trajectory loss along the student's own reverse process, confidence reweighting that down-weights tokens where the teacher is unsure, and a trust-region anchor that stabilizes the moving target. On MDLM, the resulting student attains a GPT-2 perplexity of $24.75$, surpassing the teacher's $27.04$; on Dream-7B distillation to a 93M student model, the framework reduces Qwen-2.5 perplexity from the FKL-distilled baseline of $25.23$ to $19.83$ while preserving performance on zero-shot general capability benchmarks.
articles.titleCn: 重新思考扩散语言模型的蒸馏知识
articles.abstractCn: 知识蒸馏最近被证明对改进自回归模型非常有效，但其对动态语言模型（DLMs）的适用性仍知之甚少。我们首次对DLMs的知识蒸馏（KD）进行了系统研究，揭示了经典正向KL（FKL）蒸馏的两个非直观失效： (i) 学生困惑度不会随着更多教师生成数据的增加而单调提高，以及 (ii) 在相同的教师生成语料库上，FKL蒸馏的表现不如直接用原始DLM去噪目标训练学生模型。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种针对掩码DLMs的统一、无数据蒸馏框架。首先，该框架运行一个离线策略蒸馏阶段，从静态的教师生成数据集中吸收通用知识。然后，框架采用在线策略蒸馏，包含三种技术：沿学生自身反向过程的轨迹损失、教师不确定时降低标记权重的置信度重加权，以及稳定移动目标的信任区域锚点。在MDLM上，生成的学生模型达到GPT-2困惑度24.75，超过教师的27.04；在Dream-7B蒸馏到93M学生模型上，该框架将Qwen-2.5困惑度从FKL蒸馏基线的25.23降低到19.83，同时在零样本泛化能力基准测试中保持性能。

articles.title: Refusal Is Not Scored: A Coverage Limit in Content-Based Bias Evaluation
articles.abstract: Bias audits of conversational models often discard refusals (responses such as "I can't assist with that request") before scoring, a filtering step which is rarely examined as a measurement decision even though it determines which responses an audit is capable of evaluating. This work examines what the step removes, applying seven bias-evaluation instruments spanning both deployed paradigms, three dictionary-based and four LLM-as-judge, to two intersectional datasets of 360 generated responses each. In both datasets, the filter removed a demographically skewed subset produced entirely by one of the three responder models, which refused North Korean prompts at 2.15 times the rate of American prompts on declarative content and 1.76 times on operational content. We then remove the filter and pass every refusal to all seven instruments. Bias-Lexicon scores refusals as clean, and including them shrinks the nationality disparity it reports. HurtLex appears to register the disparity, but we trace this entirely to a single lexicon entry matching the token "can" in "I can't". The LLM judges either flag most responses or rate refusals as unbiased. For the two judges that discriminate, including refusals lowers the nationality disparity they report, and no instrument identifies the refusal disparity. The failure is therefore a coverage limit upstream of scoring rather than a calibration gap that a better lexicon or judge prompt would be expected to close, which makes the behavioral channel an instrument is sensitive to a question of construct validity rather than one of method selection.
articles.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/AfifahK/bias-eval-construct-validity
articles.titleCn: 拒绝不计分：基于内容的偏差评估中的覆盖率限制
articles.abstractCn: 对话模型的偏见审计通常在评分前会丢弃拒绝（例如“我不能协助这个请求”的回应），这一过滤步骤虽然决定了审计能够评估哪些回应，却很少被作为测量决策来审视。本研究考察了这一步骤移除了什么，应用了涵盖三种部署范式的七种偏见评估工具（其中三种基于词典，四种将大型语言模型作为评判者），对两个各包含360个生成回应的交叉数据集进行分析。在两个数据集中，过滤器移除了一个由其中一种回应模型完全生成的、人口统计学上存在偏差的子集，该模型拒绝朝鲜请求的比率是美国请求的2.15倍（在声明性内容上）和1.76倍（在操作性内容上）。随后我们移除过滤器，并将所有拒绝回应提交给所有七种工具。Bias-Lexicon将拒绝回应评分为一清二白，而包含这些回应会缩小其报告的国籍差异。HurtLex似乎记录了这种差异，但我们追踪发现这完全归因于一个与“can”词匹配的词典条目。大型语言模型要么标记大多数回应，要么将拒绝回应评为无偏见。对于两种能区分回应的评判者，包含拒绝回应会缩小其报告的国籍差异，而没有任何工具能识别拒绝回应的差异。因此，这种失败是评分前的覆盖范围限制，而非更好的词典或评判者提示所能弥补的校准差距，这使得行为渠道成为工具敏感性的问题，是结构效度而非方法选择的问题。

articles.title: Rethinking Sequential Locate-Then-Edit: Optimality and Stability
articles.abstract: The Locate-Then-Edit framework enables efficient knowledge updates in large language models without requiring full retraining. Recent research has increasingly focused on sequential editing, where knowledge arrives continuously and the model is updated incrementally. However, existing sequential methods commonly suffer from catastrophic forgetting and model collapse after only a few hundred edits. In contrast, batch editing - which jointly optimizes all edits and yields the optimal solution under a specified editing objective - can support tens of thousands of edits with high edit efficacy while preserving the model's general capabilities, resulting in a substantial performance gap between the two editing paradigms. In this paper, we demonstrate that this gap can be closed via a batch-equivalent sequential editing approach. Moreover, we investigate the underlying mechanism of model degradation in existing sequential methods by analyzing the convergence behavior of weight perturbations as edits accumulate. Our analysis reveals that current methods typically exhibit linear or logarithmic growth in perturbation, whereas the proposed batch-equivalent method achieves time-invariant growth, thereby theoretically guaranteeing long-term stability and preserving the integrity of pretrained knowledge throughout massive-scale sequential editing.
articles.comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026. 10 pages of main text, 6 figures, and 2 tables. The full manuscript contains 41 pages, including references and supplementary material. This work concerns sequential knowledge editing within the locate-then-edit framework
articles.titleCn: 重新思考顺序定位后编辑：最优性和稳定性
articles.abstractCn: 定位-编辑框架能够在不进行完整再训练的情况下，高效地更新大型语言模型中的知识。近期研究越来越关注序列编辑，其中知识持续到来，模型逐步更新。然而，现有的序列方法通常在仅进行几百次编辑后就会出现灾难性遗忘和模型崩溃。相比之下，批量编辑——它联合优化所有编辑，并在指定的编辑目标下产生最优解——能够以高编辑效率支持数万次编辑，同时保留模型的一般能力，导致这两种编辑范式之间存在显著的性能差距。在本文中，我们证明了可以通过一种批量等效的序列编辑方法来缩小这一差距。此外，我们通过分析权重扰动随编辑累积的收敛行为，研究了现有序列方法中模型退化的潜在机制。我们的分析表明，当前方法通常表现出扰动呈线性或对数增长，而提出的批量等效方法实现了时间不变增长，从而从理论上保证了长期稳定性，并在大规模序列编辑过程中保持预训练知识的完整性。

articles.title: Sports Agent: A Self-Evolving System for Conversational Data Analytics
articles.abstract: Conversational sports analytics requires accurate, evidence-based responses with low latency. Changes in query distributions, data resources, and model behavior can degrade static agent configurations, motivating controlled evolution guided by runtime evidence. We present Sports Agent, a self-evolving framework integrating an Agentic SQL Model for structured-data reasoning, a harness for planning and tool orchestration, and a unified Feedback Engine connecting online execution with offline evolution. The engine assesses responses and execution trajectories, verifies factual claims, diagnoses failures, and generates evolution signals. Model evolution combines SQL-to-Question Scaling for coverage expansion with Graph-Guided Scaling for error-targeted synthesis. Generated questions undergo trajectory distillation and quality filtering for iterative supervised fine-tuning, followed by a separate Post-RL stage. Harness evolution translates recurrent failures into bounded prompt and skill updates, validated through independent audits, execution replay, and regression testing. Performance-tolerance checks guard against unacceptable degradation during simplification. The resulting Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-based model outperforms Qwen3.8-Max on sports question answering and analysis while achieving approximately three times the inference efficiency. Across 30 harness-evolution rounds, the aggregate performance score improves by 10.8 points. In a live sports analytics product, the evolved system improves factual correctness by 10.5 points and average response length, a proxy for answer richness, by 158.1%, while reducing average latency by 41.3% relative to the baseline.
articles.titleCn: 体育经纪人：一个用于对话数据分析的自我进化系统
articles.abstractCn: 对话式体育数据分析需要准确、基于证据的响应，并具有低延迟。查询分布、数据资源和模型行为的改变可能会降低静态代理配置的性能，从而促使基于运行时证据的受控进化。我们提出了Sports Agent，一个自我进化的框架，集成了用于结构化数据推理的代理式SQL模型、用于规划和工具协调的引擎，以及连接在线执行与离线进化的统一反馈引擎。该引擎评估响应和执行轨迹，验证事实性声明，诊断故障，并生成进化信号。模型进化结合了SQL到问题扩展以增加覆盖范围，以及图引导扩展以针对错误进行合成。生成的问句会经过轨迹蒸馏和质量过滤，用于迭代监督微调，随后进行独立的后强化学习阶段。引擎进化将重复出现的故障转化为有界的提示和技能更新，并通过独立审计、执行重放和回归测试进行验证。性能容忍度检查可防止在简化过程中出现不可接受的性能下降。最终基于Qwen3.6-35B-A3B的模型在体育问答和分析方面优于Qwen3.8-Max，同时实现了大约三倍的推理效率。经过30轮引擎进化，综合性能得分提高了10.8分。在一个实时体育分析产品中，进化后的系统将事实正确性提高了10.5分，平均响应长度（作为答案丰富度的代理指标）增加了158.1%，同时将平均延迟相对于基线降低了41.3%。

articles.title: NORMCRAFT: Cultural Norm Generation for Context-Aware Language Model Alignment
articles.abstract: Cultural alignment requires large language models (LLMs) to infer often-implicit social norms from a scenario and its cultural context. Existing approaches typically adapt individual models or supply external cultural knowledge, while learning norm inference independently of downstream response generation remains underexplored. We introduce NORMCRAFT, a modular framework that decouples norm inference from response generation. Through norm-centric multi-view supervision, we train an LLM as a norm generator to recover shared norms from prospective, adherence, and violation scenarios without downstream response labels. The generated norms guide a separate, frozen LLM (the responder). With Qwen3.5-4B as the responder, NORMCRAFT outperforms prompting and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) baselines on four of five downstream metrics. On SafeWorld, its responses reflect the reference norms more often (Coverage) and more precisely (Faithfulness), exceeding Responder SFT by 18.0 and 14.1 percentage points, respectively. Direct norm evaluation also shows higher norm quality than the base and few-shot generators. The same trained generator improves cultural alignment on SafeWorld across fourteen frozen LLMs spanning five families and 0.8B to 27B parameters, with the largest gains for the smallest models.
articles.titleCn: NORMCRAFT：面向情境感知语言模型对齐的文化规范生成
articles.abstractCn: 文化一致性要求大型语言模型（LLM）能够从场景及其文化背景中推断出通常隐含的社会规范。现有方法通常通过调整单个模型或提供外部文化知识来实现，而独立于下游响应生成进行规范推断的学习仍处于探索阶段。我们介绍了NORMCRAFT，这是一个模块化框架，将规范推断与响应生成解耦。通过以规范为中心的多视角监督，我们训练LLM作为规范生成器，在不依赖下游响应标签的情况下，从潜在、遵守和违规场景中恢复共享规范。生成的规范指导一个独立的、冻结的LLM（即响应者）。以Qwen3.5-4B作为响应者，NORMCRAFT在五个下游指标中的四个上优于提示和监督微调（SFT）基线。在SafeWorld上，其响应更频繁地反映参考规范（覆盖率）且更精确（忠实度），分别比Responder SFT高出18.0和14.1个百分点。直接规范评估也显示出比基础和少样本生成器更高的规范质量。同一训练好的生成器在SafeWorld上提升了十四个冻结LLM的文化一致性，这些模型涵盖五个家族，参数规模从0.8B到27B不等，其中对最小模型的增益最大。

articles.title: Tells of a Lying Machine: Analyzing LLM-Generated Strategic Dialogue in Chinese Werewolf
articles.abstract: Social-deduction games give models opposing objectives, but they also give roles different information and speaking obligations. We analyze 5,404 public utterances from 150 Chinese Werewolf games played by 12 models, comparing ordinary wolves with ordinary villagers so that special roles are excluded. Private knowledge and goals still differ, and no utterance is verified as true or false. After model and length adjustment, wolf utterances score higher on both certainty and uncertainty (coefficients +0.074 and +0.072). Emotional intensification has the largest rank-biserial effect (r = .145), but it depends on a single degree marker and correlates weakly with human-rated affect. Three annotators' ratings of 392 utterances show higher wolf scores on four behavioral dimensions, and five LLM judges reach 60.8%-70.2% accuracy on a shared evaluation set. In a generation probe that prompts six models with a wolf identity but a villager speaking goal under fixed public context, certainty (+0.164) and emotional intensification (+0.095) increase. These findings describe role-associated language rather than verified lying, and they argue for explicit comparison groups and lexicon sensitivity checks in game-based deception evaluation. Data and code are available at https://github.com/justinchoi929/Tells-of-a-Lying-Machine
articles.comment: 23 pages. Xian Cui and Gan Yang contributed equally and share first authorship
articles.titleCn: 讲述了一个谎言机器：分析中文狼人杀中大型语言模型生成的策略对话
articles.abstractCn: 社交推理类游戏为模型设定了相互冲突的目标，同时也为不同角色分配了不同的信息量和发言义务。我们分析了12位模型参与150场中文狼人杀游戏所产生的5,404条公开发言，通过对比普通狼人和普通村民（排除特殊角色）来进行分析。结果显示，私密知识与目标仍存在差异，且没有发言被证实为真或假。在调整模型和长度后，狼人的发言在确定性和不确定性上得分均更高（系数分别为+0.074和+0.072）。情绪强化具有最大的等级双列相关效应（r = .145），但它依赖于单一程度指标，且与人类评定的情感相关性较弱。三位标注者对392条发言的评分显示，狼人在四个行为维度上的得分更高，而五个大型语言模型裁判在共享评估集上的准确率达到了60.8%-70.2%。在生成探测实验中，通过设定固定公共情境下六位模型具有狼人身份但村民发言目标，确定性和情绪强化分别增加了(+0.164)和(+0.095)。这些发现描述了与角色相关的语言特征，而非验证性的谎言，并主张在基于游戏的欺骗评估中应明确比较组和词汇敏感性检查。数据与代码可在https://github.com/justinchoi929/Tells-of-a-Lying-Machine获取。
